notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). Unlike the 1Q2026 file (scanned), the statements and notes have a text layer (Thai glyphs partly garbled, figures intact); figures read from the page text and checked against the page totals (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (KPMG). Million Baht. SCI three months p.6, six months p.8. Revenue 11.1 p.29 (non-PAA components + PAA revenue) and expenses 11.2 p.30 (printed positive, turned negative; incurred claims = claims and benefits + other insurance service expenses; no past-service line). CSM roll-forward 1.2 p.33 (period to 30 มิถุนายน 2569); future-service change = change in estimates (CSM column). New business 1.3 p.35. RA release uses 11.1 (422), not the AOC RA (337). Other expense = finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.6).
